description: Search French companies by name and get their SIREN (9-digit business ID). Returns up to 10 matches with SIREN, name, active status, NAF activity code, city and postcode. Optional postcode filter. Official INSEE Sirene data. Use it first when you only know a company name, then call company_health_check (full vetting) or company_profile with the SIREN. Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

q.description: Company name to search (3 characters minimum), e.g. boulangerie

name: company_search
title: Search French companies by name
